_readme: Every subteam card on /about lives in this file.
Add one by copying a block below and giving it the next `order` number.
`order` sorts the cards low to high. Text containing PLACEHOLDER renders muted
and italic on the live site, so unfinished copy is easy to spot.

subteams.name: Design / CAD
subteams.description: Designs the robot and turns ideas into detailed CAD models and assemblies.

subteams.name: Fabrication
subteams.description: Turns designs into hardware through machining, cutting, 3D printing, assembly, and hands-on fabrication.

subteams.name: Electrical
subteams.description: Builds the robot's electrical system and wires motors, sensors, and other electrical components.

subteams.name: Software
subteams.description: Programs the robot's controls, autonomous routines, vision, and other systems that bring the robot to life.

subteams.name: Business / Outreach
subteams.description: Handles sponsors, fundraising, communications, outreach, and the backbone of our team that keeps us running.

subteams.name: Strategy / Scouting
subteams.description: Studies the game and develops match strategies to help Nyx make better decisions on the field.
